Rashi on Chullin 56a:10:1.english: But not with a nail - Because it destroys the property of Israel:

Rashi on Chullin 56a:10:2.english: [If] the bone was broken - [The Gemara] objects [to this] further on.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:10:3.hebrew: וקרומו רך - הלכך, כי נשבר העצם, תו לא קאי קרום:
Rashi on Chullin 56a:10:3.english: And its membrane is fragile - Therefore, when the bone is broken, the membrane no longer remains [intact].

Rashi on Chullin 56a:11:1.english: Rav Naḥman said to Rav Anan - I wonder at this.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:11:2.hebrew: מר אמר - אתה אמרת לי שראית שמואל שהוא בודק לנשיכת חולדה, אלמא לא מטרף בעצם לחודיה. ואף הונא חברין אמר לי דאיהו חזייה לרב דבדיק בידא, וקשיא לי: והא תני לוי כו':
Rashi on Chullin 56a:11:2.english: The Master says - You told me that you saw Shmuel inspecting for a weasel bite, which shows that [a bird] does not become a tereifah through the bone alone. And our colleague Huna also told me that he saw Rav inspecting by hand. And it is difficult to me: But doesn't Levi teach, etc.?

Rashi on Chullin 56a:11:3.hebrew: כנגדן בעוף - במידי דאיתיה בעוף — המסס ובית הכוסות ליתנהו בעוף:
Rashi on Chullin 56a:11:3.english: Corresponding to them in a bird - [This applies only] to that which exists in a bird — the omasum and the reticulum do not exist in a bird.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:13:1.hebrew: בדיק בשימשא - נגד השמש מסתכל אם יראה נקב, שהאור יפה לבדיקה:
Rashi on Chullin 56a:13:1.english: Would inspect in the sun - He looks toward the sun [to see] if a perforation will be seen, for light is good for inspection.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:13:2.hebrew: במיא - מוציא כל המוח מן הקרום דרך פיה, כמו שהיא יורדת לחוט השדרה, וממלא הקרום מים; ואם יוצא דרך המכה — בידוע שניקב הקרום. ל"א: מכניס בנקב העצם מים וחוזר ומוציאו, ורואה: אם נתלבנו — בידוע שנתערב המוח בהם:
Rashi on Chullin 56a:13:2.english: With water - He removes all the brain from the membrane through its opening, where it descends to the spinal cord, and fills the membrane with water; and if [water] emerges through the wound, it is known that the membrane was perforated. Another explanation: He introduces water into the hole in the bone and draws it back out, and sees: if [the water] turned white, it is known that the brain was mixed with it.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:1:1.hebrew: להביא עור בית הבושת - להכי מפרש ואמר: "להביא עור בית הבושת" — משום דאין להביא אלא זה לבדו; שהרי כל המנויין שם הראויין להיות בעולה שנויין כאן, חוץ מזה. עור השליל אינו ראוי להיות בעולה, דאין שליל לזכרים:
Rashi on Chullin 56a:1:1.english: To include the hide of the vulva - It is for this [reason] that [the Tanna] explains and says, "to include the hide of the vulva" — because there is nothing [else] to include except for this alone; for all those enumerated there that are suitable to be in a burnt offering are taught here, except for this [one]. [And] the hide of a fetus is not suitable to be in a burnt offering, as there is no fetus among males.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:1:2.english: The vulva - The womb of a female.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:2:1.hebrew: ואלו טריפות בעוף - אע"ג דכל טריפות דבהמה כנגדן בעוף, הני אצטריכו ליה למיתני: נקובת הוושט — משום פסוקת הגרגרת; וההוא איצטריך, דלא תימא: הואיל וחיותו של עוף לא נפיש, דהא כשר בסימן אחד, אימא גרגרת נמי תיטרף במשהו. והכתה חולדה — משום דקתני "מקום שעושה אותה טרפה", דהיינו נקיבת הקרום, דלא תימא תיטרף בנשבר העצם בלא נקיבת קרום, כדאמרי' לקמן בעוף של מים. וניקבו הדקין — משום דקבעי למיתני סיפא גבי אלו כשירות: "יצאו בני מעיה ולא ניקבו", ולא תימא: עוף שחיותו מועט תיטרף ביציאה לחודה:
Rashi on Chullin 56a:2:1.english: And these are tereifot in a bird - Even though all the tereifot of an animal have their counterparts in a bird, these [cases] were necessary for it to teach: [It taught] a perforated gullet on account of a severed windpipe; and that [case of a severed windpipe] was necessary, so that you should not say: Since the vitality of a bird is not great — as it is kosher with [only] one organ [of slaughter] — say that its windpipe should also be rendered a tereifa with any amount [of perforation]! And [it taught that] a weasel struck [its head] because it teaches "a place that renders it a tereifa," which is perforation of the membrane [of the brain], so that you should not say that it should be rendered a tereifa by the breaking of the bone without perforation of the membrane, as we say later regarding a waterfowl. And [it taught that] the small intestines were perforated because it needed to teach in the latter clause regarding "these are kosher": "its intestines emerged and were not perforated," so that you should not say that a bird, whose vitality is minimal, should be rendered a tereifa by the emergence [of the intestines] alone.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:2:2.english: A weasel struck [it] on its head - We are concerned about a perforation of the [brain] membrane.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:2:3.hebrew: הכתה - נשכתה בשיניה; דאילו ביד — אמרן לעיל (חולין דף נג.) יש דרוסה לחולדה בעופות, וכל כנגד החלל מיטרפה בה:
Rashi on Chullin 56a:2:3.english: [A weasel] struck - It bit [the bird] with its teeth; for if [it struck it] with [its] foreleg, we said above (Chullin 53a) [that] a weasel has [the law of] clawing [derisah] regarding birds, and anywhere opposite the [body] cavity, [the bird] is rendered a tereifah by it.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:2:4.hebrew: נחמרו - כווצו מחמת האור, ונהפכה מראיתן; לשון (איכה א): "מעי חמרמרו":
Rashi on Chullin 56a:2:4.english: Were singed - They shriveled on account of the fire and their appearance changed; an expression [similar to] (Lamentations 1): “My innards churned.”

Rashi on Chullin 56a:2:5.hebrew: אם הוריקו - מפרש בגמרא: לב וקורקבן אדומין שהוריקו, וירוקין שהאדימו:
Rashi on Chullin 56a:2:5.english: If they turned green - It is explained in the Gemara: [This refers to] the heart and gizzard — [naturally] red [organs] that turned green, and [naturally] green [organs] that turned red.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:2:6.hebrew: אם אדומים - הלב והקורקבן כמשפטן, שלא נשתנה מראה שלהן:
Rashi on Chullin 56a:2:6.english: If [they are] red - The heart and the gizzard [remain] in their normal state, as their appearance did not change.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:2:7.english: Trampled it - A person [trampled it] with his feet.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:2:8.english: Or slammed it against a wall - He struck it against a wall.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:2:9.hebrew: או שריצצתה בהמה - דאיכא למיחש להני תלתא משום ריסוק איברים, ועדיין מפרכסת — אם שהתה מעת לעת ושחטה, כשרה. ובדיקה בעיא, כדאוקמינן בפירקין (דף נא:):
Rashi on Chullin 56a:2:9.english: Or if an animal crushed it - For there is reason to be concerned regarding these three [cases] on account of shattered limbs; and [even while] it is still twitching — if it survived for a twenty-four-hour period and one slaughtered it, it is kosher. And it requires inspection, as we established in our chapter (51b).

Rashi on Chullin 56a:3:1.hebrew: מכניס ידו - בפיו של עוף שנשכתו חולדה בראשו. ובודק — דוחק אצבעו כלפי חיך העוף, והמוח נדחק למעלה, אם המוח מבצבץ ויוצא דרך נקב המכה:
Rashi on Chullin 56a:3:1.english: Inserts his hand - Into the mouth of a bird that a weasel bit on its head. And "checks" — he presses his finger toward the palate of the bird, and the brain is pressed upward, [to see] if the brain oozes and emerges through the hole of the wound.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:3:2.english: [It is] a tereifa - For perhaps the membrane was perforated.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:4:1.hebrew: הניחא למאן דאמר - לעיל (חולין דף מה.) גבי ניקב הקרום, עד דמינקיב עילאה ותתאה — שפיר:
Rashi on Chullin 56a:4:1.english: This works out well according to the one who says - Above (Chullin 45a), regarding [the case of] "the membrane was perforated," [that it is not a tereifa] until the upper and lower [membranes] are perforated — [it works out] well.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:4:2.hebrew: אלא למאן דאמר - דטריף עילאה לחודיה, כי לא מבצבץ אמאי כשרה? דלמא עילאה אינקיב ותתאה קיים:
Rashi on Chullin 56a:4:2.english: But according to the one who says - that [perforation of] the outer [membrane] alone renders [the animal] a tereifa, when [the brain] does not ooze out, why is it kosher? Perhaps the outer [membrane] was perforated and the inner [membrane] is intact.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:4:3.english: The inner [membrane] will burst - By the push of a finger, when one pushes it upward.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:5:1.english: There is no inspection for a weasel - [That is,] for the bite of a weasel.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:5:2.hebrew: מפני ששיניה דקות - ואפילו ניקב הקרום, פעמים שאין המוח יוצא על ידי דחיפת אצבע בחיך:
Rashi on Chullin 56a:5:2.english: Because its teeth are thin - And even if the membrane was perforated, there are times that the brain does not emerge by means of pushing a finger against the palate:

Rashi on Chullin 56a:5:3.english: What of it? - It is impossible that a little bit [of the brain] would not ooze out.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:5:4.hebrew: ועקומות - ונוקב באלכסון, וכשהמוח נדחף למעלה, העצם סותמו ועומד כנגדו, שנקב העצם אינו כנגד נקב הקרום:
Rashi on Chullin 56a:5:4.english: And crooked - And it punctures at an angle, and when the brain is pushed upward, the bone blocks it and stands against it, for the hole in the bone is not aligned with the perforation in the membrane.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:6:1.english: When he went up - Ze’eiri [went] from Babylonia to Neharde’a.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:6:2.hebrew: ביד - כדמפרש לעיל, מכניס ידו כו':
Rashi on Chullin 56a:6:2.english: With [one’s] hand - As [the Gemara] explains above: One inserts his hand, etc.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:6:3.hebrew: אבל לא במסמר - מלמעלה מוליכו על הנקב לראות אם יחגור בקרום, ופותח את הגולגולת תחלה לאחר שחיטה. ופעמים שאינו נקוב, והמסמר נוקבו, ומפסיד ממון ישראל:
Rashi on Chullin 56a:6:3.english: But not with a nail - From above, one passes it [the nail] over the puncture to see whether it will catch on the membrane; and one opens the skull first, after slaughtering. And at times [the membrane] is not perforated, and the nail perforates it, and [thus] causes a loss of Jewish money.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:6:4.hebrew: אף במסמר - בודקין, ולא חיישינן לדלמא איהו נקיב ליה. בידא — כדמפרש:
Rashi on Chullin 56a:6:4.english: Even with a nail - One may inspect [with it], and we are not concerned that perhaps it [the nail itself] will puncture it. And [inspection] by hand [is valid] as explained.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:7:1.english: With a needle - As I explained [regarding inspection] with a nail.

Rashi on Chullin 56a:8:1.hebrew: ניקב קרום - מתוך ששיניה דקות ועקומות, אינו מבצבץ:
Rashi on Chullin 56a:8:1.english: The membrane was perforated - Since its [i.e., the weasel's] teeth are thin and curved, [the brain] does not ooze out.

Tosafot on Chullin 56a:11:1.hebrew: מר אמר שמואל בדיק בידא וכן רב - ואף על גב דכבר אמרינן לעיל: "רב ושמואל ולוי דאמרי מכניס ידו לפנים ובודק", מ"מ אשמועינן הכא דמעשה נמי עבד:
Tosafot on Chullin 56a:11:1.english: "The Master says Shmuel inspects by hand, and similarly Rav" - And even though we already said above: "Rav and Shmuel and Levi, who say: One inserts his hand inside and inspects," nevertheless, [the Gemara] teaches us here that he also acted in practice.

Tosafot on Chullin 56a:11:2.hebrew: והא תני לוי טרפות שמנו חכמים וכו' - בחנם מקשה מברייתא ארב ושמואל, דאלוי גופיה הוה מצי למפרך — דאמר לעיל: מכניס ידו לפנים ובודק:
Tosafot on Chullin 56a:11:2.english: "But doesn’t Levi teach: [Those] tereifot that the Sages enumerated, etc." - [Rav Naḥman] needlessly objects from the baraita against Rav and Shmuel, for he could have objected against Levi himself, as [Levi] stated above: "He inserts his hand inside and inspects."

Tosafot on Chullin 56a:1:1.hebrew: להביא עור של בית הבושת - לקמן בהעור והרוטב (חולין דף קכב.) פירש רש"י: הא דלא חשיב ליה בהדיא בהדי אינך בברייתא — משום דבעולה מיירי, שהוא זכר. ומיהו, איכא מאן דתני "זבח" בפרק כל הזבחים שקיבלו (זבחים כח. ושם), ולא קתני "עולה". ויש לומר: דלא חשיב אלא מידי דהוה בכל הקרבנות; ועור שתחת האליה, אע"ג דאינה קרבה אלא בכבש, מ"מ איתיה או באכילת אדם או באכילת מזבח. וא"ת: אמאי לא קאמר נמי "להביא עור השליל", דחשיב לקמן במתניתין בהעור והרוטב (חולין דף קכב.) בהדי אלו שעורותיהם כבשרן? ואומר ר"ת: משום דאין מפגלים בשליל, כדאיתא פרק כל הפסולין (זבחים לה.): פיגל בשליל — לא נתפגל הזבח, ואף השליל לא נתפגל:
Tosafot on Chullin 56a:1:1.english: "To include the hide of the vulva" - Later in [the chapter entitled] HaOhr VehaRotev (Chullin 122a), Rashi explained that the reason it [the baraita] did not enumerate it explicitly together with the others in the baraita is because it is dealing with an olah (burnt offering), which is [only] a male. However, there is an authority who teaches the version "a sacrifice [zevach]" in the chapter [entitled] Kol HaZevachim SheKiblu (Zevachim 28a, and see there), and does not teach "an olah." And it can be said that it [the baraita] enumerates only something that is present in all sacrifices; and [as for] the hide beneath the fat tail, even though it [the fat tail] is offered [on the altar] only in [the case of] a lamb, nevertheless it is [present in all sacrifices] either for human consumption or for the altar's consumption. And if you say: Why does it [the Gemara] not also say, "[It comes] to include the hide of the fetus," which is enumerated later in our Mishnah in HaOhr VehaRotev (Chullin 122a) among those whose hides are like their flesh? And Rabbeinu Tam says: Because one cannot render [an offering] piggul through a fetus, as it is stated in the chapter [entitled] Kol HaPesulin (Zevachim 35a): If one had piggul intent concerning a fetus, the sacrifice is not rendered piggul, and even the fetus is not rendered piggul.

Tosafot on Chullin 56a:6:1.hebrew: ורבי יוחנן אמר אף במסמר - וליכא משום מכלה ממונן של ישראל. ובפלוגתא — לאו דוקא; דרבי יוחנן, דאמר "אף במסמר", לא כרבי יהודה ולא כרבי נחמיה:
Tosafot on Chullin 56a:6:1.english: “And Rabbi Yoḥanan says: Even with a nail” - And there is no [concern] of wasting the property of the Jewish people. And [the Gemara’s statement that this is] “in the dispute” [of Rabbi Yehuda and Rabbi Neḥemya] is not exact, for Rabbi Yoḥanan, who said “even with a nail,” is neither in accordance with Rabbi Yehuda nor in accordance with Rabbi Neḥemya.

Tosafot on Chullin 56a:8:1.hebrew: נבלות והא שחוטה היא - וא"ת: והא שמעינן ליה לרבי יהודה, דאמר פרק חטאת העוף (זבחים סט: ושם), דשחיטת העוף אינה מטהרת טריפתה מטומאתה — דקאמר: "נבלה וטרפה לא יאכל לטמאה בה", טרפה למה נאמרה? להביא טרפה ששחטה (שחלבה טהור, מכלל שהיא מטמאה). וכן ריש מסכת טהרות גבי י"ג דברים נאמרו בנבלת עוף טהור: "שחיטתה ומליקתה מטהרת טרפתה מידי נבלה, רבי יהודה אומר: אינה מטהרת"? וי"ל: דמ"מ, כיון דלר' נחמיה מטהרת, לא הוה ליה למימר שהיה מאכיל נבילות. ועוד, דלא מסיק אדעתיה "תסתיים דרבי יהודה הוא דבדיק בידא":
Tosafot on Chullin 56a:8:1.english: "Carcasses? But this is a slaughtered [animal]" - And if you say: But didn't we hear Rabbi Yehuda say in the chapter [entitled] Chatat HaOf (Zevachim 69b and there) that the slaughter of a bird does not purify its tereifah from its impurity — for he says: "A carcass and a tereifah he shall not eat, to become defiled by it" (Leviticus 22:8); why was "a tereifah" stated? To include a tereifah that one slaughtered (that its fat is pure, which implies that it imparts impurity). And similarly, [at] the beginning of tractate Tohorot, regarding [the Mishnah]: "Thirteen matters were stated concerning the carcass of a kosher bird: Its slaughter and its pinching purify its tereifah from [the status of] a carcass; Rabbi Yehuda says: It does not purify [it]"? And one can say: That nevertheless, since according to Rabbi Neḥemya [slaughter] purifies [it], he should not have said that he was feeding [the Jewish people] carcasses. And furthermore, [the Gemara when asking its question] had not yet considered: "It may be concluded that it is Rabbi Yehuda who inspected by hand."
